entries.query_str: dublin weather in july, do i need a real jacket
entries.answer: Dublin in July is mild: average highs around **19–20 °C (66–68 °F)** and lows around **11–12 °C (52–54 °F)**, with rain on roughly a third of days, usually light showers [1][2]. Bring a **light waterproof jacket** and a layer like a sweater; a heavy coat isn't needed. Evenings by the coast can feel cooler with wind [2].
